# Referral voucher and merchant credit platform (2026-01-20 18:23Z)

_**User (2026-01-20 18:23Z)**_

You are Cursor acting as a senior full-stack engineer and product builder. Build a production-ready, global, multi-tenant “Referral Voucher + Merchant Credit” platform that works on Web and Mobile (PWA-first). Deliver a working codebase with clean structure, migrations, seed data, and a polished UI.

# 0) PRODUCT GOAL
Create a platform where merchants can issue brand-custom vouchers (weekly drops included). Users share vouchers with friends; when friends redeem, referrers earn merchant-specific discount credit (not money). The system must be web-first, mobile-native via PWA, and global by design (i18n, currencies, regions).

# 1) TECH STACK (LOCKED)
Frontend:
- Next.js (App Router) + React + TypeScript
- TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui
- PWA (manifest, service worker, offline QR rendering)
- i18n: next-intl (English default, structure ready for more locales)

Backend:
- Next.js Route Handlers (server actions where useful) OR separate Node API, but prefer Next fullstack to ship fast.
- Auth: NextAuth (Email magic link + Google + Apple)
- RBAC roles: platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user

Data:
- PostgreSQL
- Prisma ORM
- Redis (rate limiting, referral locks, anti-fraud signals) – optional for local dev, required in prod
- Object storage for uploaded brand assets (S3 compatible)

Infra:
- Docker compose for local (Postgres, Redis)
- Env-based config for production deployment (Vercel/Render/Fly/Hetzner okay)

# 2) MULTI-TENANCY MODEL
- Each merchant is a tenant.
- Users can belong to multiple merchants (credits are per-merchant).
- Voucher design and rules are per-merchant.
- Use row-level tenant enforcement in server layer.

# 3) CORE FLOWS (MUST WORK END-TO-END)
A) Merchant creates voucher:
- choose voucher type: percentage | fixed_amount | credit_amount
- set value, currency, validity, usage limits, conditions
- optional Weekly Drop schedule (day/time window, stock count)
- design voucher visually (brand: logo, colors, background, headline, fine print)
- publish voucher and obtain share link template

B) User shares voucher:
- user opens voucher landing page on mobile
- taps “Share” => native share sheet + copy link + QR
- referral link includes referrer + voucher identifiers
- friend can open without account

C) Friend redeems voucher:
- friend sees branded voucher with QR + code
- redemption can happen by:
  1) “Online redeem” (enter code at checkout simulation in MVP)
  2) “In-store redeem” (merchant staff scans QR; marks redeemed)
- after redemption confirmation, referrer gets credit in LOCKED state
- credit unlock conditions: redemption confirmed (and optional cooldown window)

D) Referrer uses credit:
- referrer sees credit wallet for that merchant
- can generate “apply credit” token
- in MVP: apply credit to a test checkout page for that merchant

# 4) DATA MODEL (PRISMA SCHEMA REQUIRED)
Implement Prisma models (names can vary but must map cleanly):

Merchant:
- id (cuid)
- name
- slug (unique)
- country
- defaultCurrency
- brandLogoUrl
- brandColorsJson
- createdAt, updatedAt

MerchantMember:
- id
- merchantId
- userId
- role (merchant_admin | merchant_staff)
- createdAt

User:
- id
- email
- name
- createdAt

Voucher:
- id
- merchantId
- status (draft | published | paused | ended)
- type (percentage | fixed_amount | credit_amount)
- value (int in minor units for money types, or basis points for percentage)
- currency
- validFrom, validTo
- usageLimitTotal (nullable)
- usageLimitPerUser (nullable)
- weeklyDropEnabled (bool)
- weeklyDropJson (dayOfWeek, startTime, stock, durationMinutes)
- conditionsJson (minPurchase, newCustomersOnly, channels, etc.)
- designJson (builder output)
- codePrefix (for human codes)
- createdAt, updatedAt

Referral:
- id
- voucherId
- merchantId
- referrerUserId
- friendHash (hash of friend identifier; do NOT store raw phone/email)
- status (created | opened | redeemed | expired | blocked)
- createdAt, updatedAt

Redemption:
- id
- voucherId
- merchantId
- referralId (nullable)
- redeemedByUserId (nullable)
- redeemedByStaffUserId (nullable)
- method (online | in_store)
- orderReference (string)
- amountBeforeDiscount (int minor units)
- discountApplied (int minor units)
- currency
- confirmedAt
- createdAt

CreditLedger:
- id
- merchantId
- userId
- amount (int minor units)
- currency
- status (locked | available | used | expired | reversed)
- source (referral_redemption | manual_adjustment)
- sourceId (string)
- expiresAt
- createdAt

CreditUsage:
- id
- merchantId
- userId
- creditLedgerIds (relation or join table)
- amountUsed
- orderReference
- createdAt

Also add AuditLog:
- id, merchantId nullable, actorUserId, action, payloadJson, createdAt

# 5) BUSINESS RULES (STRICT)
- Credit is NOT cash and cannot be transferred or withdrawn.
- Credit is per-merchant and denominated in merchant currency.
- Credit expires (default 60 days; merchant can override).
- Prevent self-referral: same user cannot redeem their own referral link.
- Referral credit is created LOCKED; it becomes AVAILABLE only when redemption is CONFIRMED.
- Weekly Drop: enforce stock; first N claims create referrals; after stock is gone, show “Sold out”.
- Usage limits: total and per user enforced atomically.
- Fraud controls:
  - rate limit redemption attempts
  - device/IP heuristics stored as risk signals (no invasive tracking; just basic)
  - block suspicious patterns (configurable thresholds)

# 6) UI REQUIREMENTS (POLISHED)
Use shadcn/ui, clean layout, fast flows.

Public pages (no login required):
- /m/[merchantSlug] (merchant public landing)
- /v/[voucherId] (voucher landing, branded, share actions)
- /r/[referralId] (referral landing; friend sees voucher and redeem options)

Auth pages:
- /login (magic link + OAuth)

User pages:
- /app (user home)
- /app/[merchantSlug]/wallet (credit balance, ledger list, expiry)
- /app/[merchantSlug]/vouchers (available vouchers to share)
- /app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo (apply voucher + credit demo)

Merchant dashboard (merchant_admin/staff):
- /merchant/[merchantSlug]/dashboard (KPIs)
- /merchant/[merchantSlug]/vouchers (list, create, edit, pause)
- /merchant/[merchantSlug]/vouchers/new (wizard + builder)
- /merchant/[merchantSlug]/redemptions (table, filter, confirm)
- /merchant/[merchantSlug]/members (invite/manage roles)
- /merchant/[merchantSlug]/settings (brand, currency, credit rules)

Platform admin:
- /admin (merchants overview, flags, fraud alerts, global settings)

Voucher Builder UI:
- left: controls (logo, colors, headline, details, background)
- center: live preview (mobile + desktop toggles)
- output: designJson saved; render uses that JSON

# 7) PWA REQUIREMENTS
- Add manifest.json, icons
- Service worker caching for public voucher pages
- Offline QR generation for already opened voucher/referral
- Install prompt hints (non-intrusive)
- Ensure iOS compatible PWA basics

# 8) API (ROUTE HANDLERS) + VALIDATION
Implement route handlers with zod validation:
- POST /api/merchant/:slug/vouchers
- PUT /api/merchant/:slug/vouchers/:id
- POST /api/vouchers/:id/publish
- POST /api/referrals/create (voucherId, optional friend hint => returns referralId + shareUrl)
- POST /api/redemptions (voucherId/referralId, method, orderReference, amounts)
- POST /api/redemptions/:id/confirm (staff/admin)
- POST /api/credits/apply (merchantSlug, amount, orderReference) => creates usage + marks ledger used
- GET /api/wallet/:merchantSlug (balance + ledger)
- POST /api/weekly-drop/claim (voucherId) => atomically claim stock and create referral

All writes must be atomic and safe (use transactions).

# 9) SECURITY & PRIVACY
- Never store raw friend phone/email; store salted hash.
- RBAC enforcement on every merchant route.
- CSRF protected where applicable.
- AuditLog for admin/staff actions.
- Rate limiting for referral creation and redemption endpoints.
- Sanitization for uploaded images / URLs.

# 10) SEED DATA
Provide prisma seed:
- 2 merchants (different currencies)
- each with 2 vouchers (one weekly drop)
- 2 users (one merchant_admin, one regular)
- sample redemptions and credits

# 11) TESTING
Add minimal tests:
- unit tests for business rules (usage limits, weekly drop stock, self-referral prevention, credit unlock)
- integration test for redemption->credit unlock pipeline
Use Vitest or Jest.

# 12) DOCS
Include:
- README: setup, env vars, local run, migrations, seed
- API docs: endpoints list and examples
- “How to add a new locale” and “How to add a new merchant currency”

# 13) DELIVERABLES
- Complete Next.js project
- Prisma schema + migrations
- Seed script
- PWA assets
- Polished UI with shadcn
- Production-ready patterns (logging, env validation, error handling)

# 14) IMPLEMENTATION NOTES (IMPORTANT)
- Prefer clarity and correctness over cleverness.
- Keep code modular:
  - /lib/auth, /lib/rbac, /lib/tenant, /lib/fraud, /lib/credits
  - /app routes separated by public/user/merchant/admin
- Use server actions where it reduces boilerplate, but keep API endpoints for integrations.
- Ensure the entire core flow is demonstrable locally after seed:
  1) open voucher landing
  2) create referral/share
  3) redeem as staff
  4) confirm redemption
  5) see credit appear and become available
  6) apply credit in checkout demo

Now build it. Start by scaffolding the repository, Prisma schema and migrations, then implement auth + RBAC + tenant enforcement, then public voucher/referral pages, then merchant dashboard and voucher builder, then redemption + credit pipeline, and finally tests and docs.

+ // This is your Prisma schema file,
+ // learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema
+ 
+ generator client {
+   provider = "prisma-client-js"
+ }
+ 
+ datasource db {
+   provider = "postgresql"
+   url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
+ }
+ 
+ model Account {
+   id                String  @id @default(cuid())
+   userId            String
+   type              String
+   provider          String
+   providerAccountId String
+   refresh_token     String? @db.Text
+   access_token      String? @db.Text
+   expires_at        Int?
+   token_type        String?
+   scope             String?
+   id_token          String? @db.Text
+   session_state     String?
+ 
+   user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
+ 
+   @@unique([provider, providerAccountId])
+   @@index([userId])
+ }
+ 
+ model Session {
+   id           String   @id @default(cuid())
+   sessionToken String   @unique
+   userId       String
+   expires      DateTime
+   user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
+ 
+   @@index([userId])
+ }
+ 
+ model VerificationToken {
+   identifier String
+   token      String   @unique
+   expires    DateTime
+ 
+   @@unique([identifier, token])
+ }
+ 
+ model User {
+   id            String    @id @default(cuid())
+   email         String    @unique
+   emailVerified DateTime?
+   name          String?
+   image         String?
+   createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
+   updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt
+ 
+   accounts         Account[]
+   sessions         Session[]
+   merchantMembers  MerchantMember[]
+   referrals        Referral[]         @relation("Referrer")
+   redemptions      Redemption[]        @relation("RedeemedBy")
+   staffRedemptions Redemption[]        @relation("RedeemedByStaff")
+   creditLedgers    CreditLedger[]
+   creditUsages     CreditUsage[]
+   auditLogs        AuditLog[]
+ }
+ 
+ model Merchant {
+   id              String   @id @default(cuid())
+   name            String
+   slug            String   @unique
+   country         String
+   defaultCurrency String   @default("USD")
+   brandLogoUrl    String?
+   brandColorsJson String?  @db.Json
+   createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
+   updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt
+ 
+   members      MerchantMember[]
+   vouchers     Voucher[]
+   referrals    Referral[]
+   redemptions  Redemption[]
+   creditLedgers CreditLedger[]
+   creditUsages  CreditUsage[]
+   auditLogs    AuditLog[]
+ }
+ 
+ model MerchantMember {
+   id        String   @id @default(cuid())
+   merchantId String
+   userId    String
+   role      String   // merchant_admin | merchant_staff
+   createdAt DateTime @default(now())
+   updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
+ 
+   merchant Merchant @relation(fields: [merchantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
+   user     User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
+ 
+   @@unique([merchantId, userId])
+   @@index([merchantId])
+   @@index([userId])
+ }
+ 
+ model Voucher {
+   id                String   @id @default(cuid())
+   merchantId        String
+   status            String   @default("draft") // draft | published | paused | ended
+   type              String   // percentage | fixed_amount | credit_amount
+   value             Int      // minor units for money, basis points for percentage
+   currency          String
+   validFrom         DateTime
+   validTo           DateTime
+   usageLimitTotal   Int?
+   usageLimitPerUser Int?
+   weeklyDropEnabled Boolean  @default(false)
+   weeklyDropJson    String?  @db.Json
+   conditionsJson    String?  @db.Json
+   designJson        String?  @db.Json
+   codePrefix        String?
+   createdAt         DateTime @default(now())
+   updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt
+ 
+   merchant   Merchant    @relation(fields: [merchantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
+   referrals  Referral[]
+   redemptions Redemption[]
+ 
+   @@index([merchantId])
+   @@index([status])
+   @@index([validFrom, validTo])
+ }
+ 
+ model Referral {
+   id            String   @id @default(cuid())
+   voucherId     String
+   merchantId    String
+   referrerUserId String
+   friendHash    String   // hash of friend identifier (phone/email)
+   status        String   @default("created") // created | opened | redeemed | expired | blocked
+   createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
+   updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt
+ 
+   voucher    Voucher     @relation(fields: [voucherId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
+   merchant   Merchant    @relation(fields: [merchantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
+   referrer   User        @relation("Referrer", fields: [referrerUserId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
+   redemption Redemption?
+ 
+   @@index([voucherId])
+   @@index([merchantId])
+   @@index([referrerUserId])
+   @@index([friendHash])
+   @@index([status])
+ }
+ 
+ model Redemption {
+   id                  String    @id @default(cuid())
+   voucherId           String
+   merchantId           String
+   referralId          String?
+   redeemedByUserId    String?
+   redeemedByStaffUserId String?
+   method              String    // online | in_store
+   orderReference      String?
+   amountBeforeDiscount Int      // minor units
+   discountApplied     Int       // minor units
+   currency            String
+   confirmedAt         DateTime?
+   createdAt           DateTime  @default(now())
+   updatedAt           DateTime  @updatedAt
+ 
+   voucher   Voucher     @relation(fields: [voucherId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
+   merchant  Merchant    @relation(fields: [merchantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
+   referral  Referral?   @relation(fields: [referralId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
+   redeemedBy User?      @relation("RedeemedBy", fields: [redeemedByUserId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
+   redeemedByStaff User? @relation("RedeemedByStaff", fields: [redeemedByStaffUserId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
+ 
+   @@index([voucherId])
+   @@index([merchantId])
+   @@index([referralId])
+   @@index([confirmedAt])
+ }
+ 
+ model CreditLedger {
+   id        String   @id @default(cuid())
+   merchantId String
+   userId    String
+   amount    Int      // minor units
+   currency  String
+   status    String   @default("locked") // locked | available | used | expired | reversed
+   source    String   // referral_redemption | manual_adjustment
+   sourceId  String
+   expiresAt DateTime?
+   createdAt DateTime @default(now())
+   updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
+ 
+   merchant Merchant @relation(fields: [merchantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
+   user     User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
+ 
+   @@index([merchantId])
+   @@index([userId])
+   @@index([status])
+   @@index([expiresAt])
+ }
+ 
+ model CreditUsage {
+   id              String   @id @default(cuid())
+   merchantId      String
+   userId          String
+   creditLedgerIds String[] // array of credit ledger IDs used
+   amountUsed      Int      // minor units
+   orderReference  String?
+   createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
+ 
+   merchant Merchant @relation(fields: [merchantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
+   user     User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
+ 
+   @@index([merchantId])
+   @@index([userId])
+ }
+ 
+ model AuditLog {
+   id          String   @id @default(cuid())
+   merchantId  String?
+   actorUserId String
+   action      String
+   payloadJson String?  @db.Json
+   createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
+ 
+   merchant Merchant? @relation(fields: [merchantId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
+   actor    User      @relation(fields: [actorUserId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
+ 
+   @@index([merchantId])
+   @@index([actorUserId])
+   @@index([action])
+   @@index([createdAt])
+ }
+ 
```

</details>

+ import { prisma } from './prisma';
+ 
+ export type Role = 'platform_admin' | 'merchant_admin' | 'merchant_staff' | 'user';
+ 
+ export interface UserWithRoles {
+   id: string;
+   email: string;
+   merchantRoles: Array&lt;{
+     merchantId: string;
+     role: 'merchant_admin' | 'merchant_staff';
+   }&gt;;
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Get user's roles across all merchants
+  */
+ export async function getUserRoles(userId: string): Promise&lt;UserWithRoles | null&gt; {
+   const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
+     where: { id: userId },
+     include: {
+       merchantMembers: {
+         select: {
+           merchantId: true,
+           role: true,
+         },
+       },
+     },
+   });
+ 
+   if (!user) return null;
+ 
+   return {
+     id: user.id,
+     email: user.email,
+     merchantRoles: user.merchantMembers.map((mm) =&gt; ({
+       merchantId: mm.merchantId,
+       role: mm.role as 'merchant_admin' | 'merchant_staff',
+     })),
+   };
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Check if user has a specific role for a merchant
+  */
+ export async function hasMerchantRole(
+   userId: string,
+   merchantId: string,
+   requiredRole: 'merchant_admin' | 'merchant_staff'
+ ): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {
+   const member = await prisma.merchantMember.findUnique({
+     where: {
+       merchantId_userId: {
+         merchantId,
+         userId,
+       },
+     },
+   });
+ 
+   if (!member) return false;
+ 
+   if (requiredRole === 'merchant_admin') {
+     return member.role === 'merchant_admin';
+   }
+ 
+   // merchant_staff can access merchant_staff routes, merchant_admin can access both
+   return member.role === 'merchant_admin' || member.role === 'merchant_staff';
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Check if user is platform admin
+  * For now, we'll use a simple env-based check. In production, add a platform_admin flag to User model.
+  */
+ export function isPlatformAdmin(userId: string): boolean {
+   const adminEmails = process.env.PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS?.split(',') || [];
+   // In production, check a flag on User model instead
+   return false; // Implement based on your needs
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Require merchant role or throw
+  */
+ export async function requireMerchantRole(
+   userId: string,
+   merchantId: string,
+   requiredRole: 'merchant_admin' | 'merchant_staff'
+ ): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+   const hasRole = await hasMerchantRole(userId, merchantId, requiredRole);
+   if (!hasRole) {
+     throw new Error('Insufficient permissions');
+   }
+ }
+

+ import { prisma } from './prisma';

+ /**
+  * Ensure a resource belongs to the specified merchant (tenant isolation)
+  */
+ export async function ensureMerchantOwnership(
+   resourceType: 'voucher' | 'referral' | 'redemption' | 'creditLedger',
+   resourceId: string,
+   merchantId: string
+ ): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {
+   switch (resourceType) {
+     case 'voucher': {
+       const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findFirst({
+         where: {
+           id: resourceId,
+           merchantId,
+         },
+       });
+       return !!voucher;
+     }
+     case 'referral': {
+       const referral = await prisma.referral.findFirst({
+         where: {
+           id: resourceId,
+           merchantId,
+         },
+       });
+       return !!referral;
+     }
+     case 'redemption': {
+       const redemption = await prisma.redemption.findFirst({
+         where: {
+           id: resourceId,
+           merchantId,
+         },
+       });
+       return !!redemption;
+     }
+     case 'creditLedger': {
+       const credit = await prisma.creditLedger.findFirst({
+         where: {
+           id: resourceId,
+           merchantId,
+         },
+       });
+       return !!credit;
+     }
+     default:
+       return false;
+   }
+ }
+

+  */

+   return prisma.merchant.findUnique({

+ interface RiskSignal {
+   type: 'rate_limit' | 'suspicious_pattern' | 'device_fingerprint';
+   severity: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
+   metadata?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;;
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Check rate limits for referral creation
+  */
+ export async function checkReferralRateLimit(
+   userId: string,
+   windowMinutes: number = 60,
+   maxAttempts: number = 10
+ ): Promise&lt;{ allowed: boolean; remaining: number }&gt; {
+   const windowStart = new Date(Date.now() - windowMinutes * 60 * 1000);
+ 
+   const recentCount = await prisma.referral.count({
+     where: {
+       referrerUserId: userId,
+       createdAt: {
+         gte: windowStart,
+       },
+     },
+   });
+ 
+   return {
+     allowed: recentCount &lt; maxAttempts,
+     remaining: Math.max(0, maxAttempts - recentCount),
+   };
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Check rate limits for redemption attempts
+  */
+ export async function checkRedemptionRateLimit(
+   friendHash: string,
+   windowMinutes: number = 60,
+   maxAttempts: number = 5
+ ): Promise&lt;{ allowed: boolean; remaining: number }&gt; {
+   const windowStart = new Date(Date.now() - windowMinutes * 60 * 1000);
+ 
+   const recentCount = await prisma.redemption.count({
+     where: {
+       referral: {
+         friendHash,
+       },
+       createdAt: {
+         gte: windowStart,
+       },
+     },
+   });
+ 
+   return {
+     allowed: recentCount &lt; maxAttempts,
+     remaining: Math.max(0, maxAttempts - recentCount),
+   };
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Prevent self-referral: check if user is trying to redeem their own referral
+  */
+ export async function isSelfReferral(
+   referralId: string,
+   userId: string
+ ): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {
+   const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({
+     where: { id: referralId },
+     select: { referrerUserId: true },
+   });
+ 
+   return referral?.referrerUserId === userId;
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Store risk signal (in production, use Redis or dedicated fraud service)
+  */
+ export async function recordRiskSignal(
+   userId: string,
+   signal: RiskSignal
+ ): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+   // In production, store in Redis or dedicated fraud table
+   // For MVP, we can log to audit log
+   await prisma.auditLog.create({
+     data: {
+       actorUserId: userId,
+       action: 'fraud.risk_signal',
+       payloadJson: JSON.stringify(signal),
+     },
+   });
+ }
+ 
```

- 
+ import { prisma } from './prisma';
+ 
+ /**
+  * Unlock credit after redemption confirmation
+  */
+ export async function unlockCreditForRedemption(
+   redemptionId: string,
+   merchantId: string
+ ): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+   const redemption = await prisma.redemption.findUnique({
+     where: { id: redemptionId },
+     include: {
+       referral: {
+         include: {
+           referrer: true,
+         },
+       },
+     },
+   });
+ 
+   if (!redemption || !redemption.referral) {
+     throw new Error('Redemption not found or has no referral');
+   }
+ 
+   if (redemption.merchantId !== merchantId) {
+     throw new Error('Merchant mismatch');
+   }
+ 
+   // Find locked credit for this redemption
+   const lockedCredit = await prisma.creditLedger.findFirst({
+     where: {
+       merchantId,
+       source: 'referral_redemption',
+       sourceId: redemptionId,
+       status: 'locked',
+     },
+   });
+ 
+   if (!lockedCredit) {
+     // Credit might already be unlocked or doesn't exist
+     return;
+   }
+ 
+   // Unlock the credit
+   await prisma.creditLedger.update({
+     where: { id: lockedCredit.id },
+     data: {
+       status: 'available',
+     },
+   });
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Get user's credit balance for a merchant
+  */
+ export async function getCreditBalance(
+   userId: string,
+   merchantId: string
+ ): Promise&lt;{
+   available: number;
+   locked: number;
+   total: number;
+   currency: string;
+   credits: Array&lt;{
+     id: string;
+     amount: number;
+     status: string;
+     expiresAt: Date | null;
+     createdAt: Date;
+   }&gt;;
+ }&gt; {
+   const credits = await prisma.creditLedger.findMany({
+     where: {
+       userId,
+       merchantId,
+       status: {
+         in: ['available', 'locked'],
+       },
+     },
+     orderBy: {
+       createdAt: 'desc',
+     },
+   });
+ 
+   const available = credits
+     .filter((c) =&gt; c.status === 'available')
+     .reduce((sum, c) =&gt; sum + c.amount, 0);
+ 
+   const locked = credits
+     .filter((c) =&gt; c.status === 'locked')
+     .reduce((sum, c) =&gt; sum + c.amount, 0);
+ 
+   const currency = credits[0]?.currency || 'USD';
+ 
+   return {
+     available,
+     locked,
+     total: available + locked,
+     currency,
+     credits: credits.map((c) =&gt; ({
+       id: c.id,
+       amount: c.amount,
+       status: c.status,
+       expiresAt: c.expiresAt,
+       createdAt: c.createdAt,
+     })),
+   };
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Apply credit to an order
+  */
+ export async function applyCredit(
+   userId: string,
+   merchantId: string,
+   amount: number,
+   orderReference: string
+ ): Promise&lt;{ success: boolean; creditIds: string[] }&gt; {
+   // Get available credits (oldest first to use expiring credits first)
+   const availableCredits = await prisma.creditLedger.findMany({
+     where: {
+       userId,
+       merchantId,
+       status: 'available',
+       OR: [
+         { expiresAt: null },
+         { expiresAt: { gt: new Date() } },
+       ],
+     },
+     orderBy: [
+       { expiresAt: 'asc' }, // Use expiring credits first
+       { createdAt: 'asc' },
+     ],
+   });
+ 
+   let remaining = amount;
+   const creditIds: string[] = [];
+   const creditsToUse: Array&lt;{ id: string; amount: number }&gt; = [];
+ 
+   for (const credit of availableCredits) {
+     if (remaining &lt;= 0) break;
+ 
+     const useAmount = Math.min(remaining, credit.amount);
+     creditsToUse.push({ id: credit.id, amount: useAmount });
+     creditIds.push(credit.id);
+     remaining -= useAmount;
+   }
+ 
+   if (remaining &gt; 0) {
+     throw new Error('Insufficient credit balance');
+   }
+ 
+   // Use transaction to atomically update credits and create usage record
+   await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {
+     // Mark credits as used (or partially used)
+     for (const { id, amount: useAmount } of creditsToUse) {
+       const credit = await tx.creditLedger.findUnique({
+         where: { id },
+       });
+ 
+       if (!credit) continue;
+ 
+       if (useAmount === credit.amount) {
+         // Fully used
+         await tx.creditLedger.update({
+           where: { id },
+           data: { status: 'used' },
+         });
+       } else {
+         // Partially used - create new ledger entry for remaining
+         await tx.creditLedger.update({
+           where: { id },
+           data: { status: 'used' },
+         });
+         await tx.creditLedger.create({
+           data: {
+             merchantId,
+             userId,
+             amount: credit.amount - useAmount,
+             currency: credit.currency,
+             status: 'available',
+             source: credit.source,
+             sourceId: credit.sourceId,
+             expiresAt: credit.expiresAt,
+           },
+         });
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     // Create usage record
+     await tx.creditUsage.create({
+       data: {
+         merchantId,
+         userId,
+         creditLedgerIds: creditIds,
+         amountUsed: amount,
+         orderReference,
+       },
+     });
+   });
+ 
+   return { success: true, creditIds };
+ }
+ 
```

+ import { type ClassValue, clsx } from "clsx"
+ import { twMerge } from "tailwind-merge"
+ 
+ export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) {
+   return twMerge(clsx(inputs))
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Format currency amount (minor units to major units)
+  */
+ export function formatCurrency(amount: number, currency: string = 'USD'): string {
+   const major = amount / 100;
+   return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
+     style: 'currency',
+     currency,
+   }).format(major);
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Format percentage (basis points to percentage)
+  */
+ export function formatPercentage(basisPoints: number): string {
+   return &#96;${(basisPoints / 100).toFixed(0)}%&#96;;
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Hash friend identifier (phone/email) for privacy
+  */
+ export async function hashFriendIdentifier(identifier: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {
+   const encoder = new TextEncoder();
+   const data = encoder.encode(identifier + process.env.AUTH_SECRET);
+   const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data);
+   const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
+   return hashArray.map((b) =&gt; b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
+ }
+ 
```

+ import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
+ import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
+ import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth';
+ import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
+ import { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';
+ import { z } from 'zod';
+ 
+ const createVoucherSchema = z.object({
+   type: z.enum(['percentage', 'fixed_amount', 'credit_amount']),
+   value: z.number().int().positive(),
+   currency: z.string(),
+   validFrom: z.string().datetime(),
+   validTo: z.string().datetime(),
+   usageLimitTotal: z.number().int().positive().optional(),
+   usageLimitPerUser: z.number().int().positive().optional(),
+   weeklyDropEnabled: z.boolean().default(false),
+   weeklyDropJson: z.any().optional(),
+   conditionsJson: z.any().optional(),
+   designJson: z.any().optional(),
+   codePrefix: z.string().optional(),
+ });
+ 
+ export async function POST(
+   req: NextRequest,
+   { params }: { params: { slug: string } }
+ ) {
+   try {
+     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
+     if (!session?.user?.id) {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
+     }
+ 
+     const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({
+       where: { slug: params.slug },
+     });
+ 
+     if (!merchant) {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });
+     }
+ 
+     await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_admin');
+ 
+     const body = await req.json();
+     const data = createVoucherSchema.parse(body);
+ 
+     const voucher = await prisma.voucher.create({
+       data: {
+         merchantId: merchant.id,
+         status: 'draft',
+         ...data,
+         validFrom: new Date(data.validFrom),
+         validTo: new Date(data.validTo),
+         weeklyDropJson: data.weeklyDropJson ? JSON.stringify(data.weeklyDropJson) : null,
+         conditionsJson: data.conditionsJson ? JSON.stringify(data.conditionsJson) : null,
+         designJson: data.designJson ? JSON.stringify(data.designJson) : null,
+       },
+     });
+ 
+     return NextResponse.json(voucher);
+   } catch (error) {
+     if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });
+     }
+     console.error('Error creating voucher:', error);
+     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ export async function GET(
+   req: NextRequest,
+   { params }: { params: { slug: string } }
+ ) {
+   try {
+     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
+     const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({
+       where: { slug: params.slug },
+     });
+ 
+     if (!merchant) {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });
+     }
+ 
+     // If authenticated and has merchant role, show all vouchers
+     // Otherwise, show only published vouchers
+     const where: any = { merchantId: merchant.id };
+     if (!session?.user?.id) {
+       where.status = 'published';
+     } else {
+       try {
+         await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');
+       } catch {
+         where.status = 'published';
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     const vouchers = await prisma.voucher.findMany({
+       where,
+       orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
+     });
+ 
+     return NextResponse.json(vouchers);
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error('Error fetching vouchers:', error);
+     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });
+   }
+ }
+

+ import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
+ import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
+ import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth';
+ import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
+ import { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';
+ import { checkReferralRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';
+ import { z } from 'zod';
+ 
+ const createReferralSchema = z.object({
+   voucherId: z.string(),
+   friendHint: z.string().optional(), // optional identifier hint for friend
+ });
+ 
+ export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
+   try {
+     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
+     if (!session?.user?.id) {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
+     }
+ 
+     const body = await req.json();
+     const { voucherId, friendHint } = createReferralSchema.parse(body);
+ 
+     // Get voucher
+     const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({
+       where: { id: voucherId },
+       include: { merchant: true },
+     });
+ 
+     if (!voucher) {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });
+     }
+ 
+     if (voucher.status !== 'published') {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });
+     }
+ 
+     // Check rate limit
+     const rateLimit = await checkReferralRateLimit(session.user.id);
+     if (!rateLimit.allowed) {
+       return NextResponse.json(
+         { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },
+         { status: 429 }
+       );
+     }
+ 
+     // Hash friend identifier if provided
+     const friendHash = friendHint
+       ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)
+       : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;
+ 
+     // Create referral
+     const referral = await prisma.referral.create({
+       data: {
+         voucherId: voucher.id,
+         merchantId: voucher.merchantId,
+         referrerUserId: session.user.id,
+         friendHash,
+         status: 'created',
+       },
+     });
+ 
+     // Generate share URL
+     const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;
+ 
+     return NextResponse.json({
+       referralId: referral.id,
+       shareUrl,
+     });
+   } catch (error) {
+     if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });
+     }
+     console.error('Error creating referral:', error);
+     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });
+   }
+ }
+

@@ -1,1 +1,152 @@
- 
+ import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
+ import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
+ import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth';
+ import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
+ import { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral } from '@/lib/fraud';
+ import { z } from 'zod';
+ 
+ const createRedemptionSchema = z.object({
+   voucherId: z.string(),
+   referralId: z.string().optional(),
+   method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),
+   orderReference: z.string().optional(),
+   amountBeforeDiscount: z.number().int().positive(),
+   discountApplied: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
+   currency: z.string(),
+ });
+ 
+ export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
+   try {
+     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
+     const body = await req.json();
+     const data = createRedemptionSchema.parse(body);
+ 
+     // Get voucher
+     const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({
+       where: { id: data.voucherId },
+       include: { merchant: true },
+     });
+ 
+     if (!voucher) {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });
+     }
+ 
+     if (voucher.status !== 'published') {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });
+     }
+ 
+     // Check validity dates
+     const now = new Date();
+     if (now &lt; voucher.validFrom || now &gt; voucher.validTo) {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher expired or not yet valid' }, { status: 400 });
+     }
+ 
+     // Check usage limits
+     if (voucher.usageLimitTotal) {
+       const totalRedemptions = await prisma.redemption.count({
+         where: {
+           voucherId: voucher.id,
+           confirmedAt: { not: null },
+         },
+       });
+       if (totalRedemptions &gt;= voucher.usageLimitTotal) {
+         return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher usage limit reached' }, { status: 400 });
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     // If referral exists, check self-referral and rate limits
+     if (data.referralId &amp;&amp; session?.user?.id) {
+       const isSelf = await isSelfReferral(data.referralId, session.user.id);
+       if (isSelf) {
+         return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Cannot redeem your own referral' }, { status: 400 });
+       }
+ 
+       const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({
+         where: { id: data.referralId },
+       });
+ 
+       if (referral) {
+         const rateLimit = await checkRedemptionRateLimit(referral.friendHash);
+         if (!rateLimit.allowed) {
+           return NextResponse.json(
+             { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },
+             { status: 429 }
+           );
+         }
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     // Create redemption (unconfirmed initially)
+     const redemption = await prisma.redemption.create({
+       data: {
+         voucherId: voucher.id,
+         merchantId: voucher.merchantId,
+         referralId: data.referralId,
+         redeemedByUserId: session?.user?.id || null,
+         method: data.method,
+         orderReference: data.orderReference,
+         amountBeforeDiscount: data.amountBeforeDiscount,
+         discountApplied: data.discountApplied,
+         currency: data.currency,
+         confirmedAt: null,
+       },
+     });
+ 
+     // If there's a referral, create locked credit
+     if (data.referralId) {
+       const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({
+         where: { id: data.referralId },
+         include: { referrer: true },
+       });
+ 
+       if (referral) {
+         // Calculate credit amount (for MVP, use a fixed percentage or voucher value)
+         let creditAmount = 0;
+         if (voucher.type === 'credit_amount') {
+           creditAmount = voucher.value;
+         } else if (voucher.type === 'fixed_amount') {
+           creditAmount = voucher.value; // Same as discount
+         } else {
+           // Percentage: give 10% of discount as credit (configurable)
+           creditAmount = Math.floor(data.discountApplied * 0.1);
+         }
+ 
+         if (creditAmount &gt; 0) {
+           const expiresAt = new Date();
+           expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + 60); // Default 60 days
+ 
+           await prisma.creditLedger.create({
+             data: {
+               merchantId: voucher.merchantId,
+               userId: referral.referrerUserId,
+               amount: creditAmount,
+               currency: voucher.currency,
+               status: 'locked',
+               source: 'referral_redemption',
+               sourceId: redemption.id,
+               expiresAt,
+             },
+           });
+ 
+           // Update referral status
+           await prisma.referral.update({
+             where: { id: data.referralId },
+             data: { status: 'redeemed' },
+           });
+         }
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     return NextResponse.json({
+       redemptionId: redemption.id,
+       requiresConfirmation: data.method === 'in_store',
+     });
+   } catch (error) {
+     if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });
+     }
+     console.error('Error creating redemption:', error);
+     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });
+   }
+ }
+ 
```

+ import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
+ import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
+ import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth';
+ import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
+ import { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';
+ import { unlockCreditForRedemption } from '@/lib/credits';
+ 
+ export async function POST(
+   req: NextRequest,
+   { params }: { params: { id: string } }
+ ) {
+   try {
+     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
+     if (!session?.user?.id) {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
+     }
+ 
+     const redemption = await prisma.redemption.findUnique({
+       where: { id: params.id },
+       include: { merchant: true },
+     });
+ 
+     if (!redemption) {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Redemption not found' }, { status: 404 });
+     }
+ 
+     if (redemption.confirmedAt) {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Redemption already confirmed' }, { status: 400 });
+     }
+ 
+     // Require merchant staff or admin role
+     await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, redemption.merchantId, 'merchant_staff');
+ 
+     // Confirm redemption
+     await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {
+       await tx.redemption.update({
+         where: { id: params.id },
+         data: { confirmedAt: new Date(), redeemedByStaffUserId: session.user.id },
+       });
+ 
+       // Unlock credit if referral exists
+       if (redemption.referralId) {
+         await unlockCreditForRedemption(params.id, redemption.merchantId);
+       }
+     });
+ 
+     return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error('Error confirming redemption:', error);
+     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });
+   }
+ }
+

+     include: {

+         include: { merchant: true },
+       },

+

+   const referralUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;
+   const qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQRCode(referralUrl);
+ 
+   // Update referral status to 'opened' if it's still 'created'
+   if (referral.status === 'created') {
+     await prisma.referral.update({

+       data: { status: 'opened' },
+     });

+       voucherCode={voucherCode}

+       isAuthenticated={!!session?.user}
+       isSelfReferral={session?.user?.id === referral.referrerUserId}
+     /&gt;
+   );
+ }

+ 'use client';
+ 
+ import { useState } from 'react';
+ import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
+ import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
+ import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
+ import { formatCurrency, formatPercentage } from '@/lib/utils';
+ import Image from 'next/image';
+ import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
+ 
+ interface ReferralClientProps {
+   referral: any;
+   voucher: any;
+   design: any;
+   brandColors: any;
+   voucherCode: string;
+   qrCodeDataUrl: string;
+   isAuthenticated: boolean;
+   isSelfReferral: boolean;
+ }
+ 
+ export default function ReferralClient({
+   referral,
+   voucher,
+   design,
+   brandColors,
+   voucherCode,
+   qrCodeDataUrl,
+   isAuthenticated,
+   isSelfReferral,
+ }: ReferralClientProps) {
+   const router = useRouter();
+   const [orderAmount, setOrderAmount] = useState('');
+   const [isRedeeming, setIsRedeeming] = useState(false);
+   const [error, setError] = useState('');
+ 
+   const getVoucherValue = () =&gt; {
+     if (voucher.type === 'percentage') {
+       return formatPercentage(voucher.value);
+     }
+     return formatCurrency(voucher.value, voucher.currency);
+   };
+ 
+   const calculateDiscount = (amount: number) =&gt; {
+     if (voucher.type === 'percentage') {
+       return Math.floor((amount * voucher.value) / 10000);
+     }
+     return Math.min(voucher.value, amount);
+   };
+ 
+   const handleRedeem = async (method: 'online' | 'in_store') =&gt; {
+     if (isSelfReferral) {
+       setError('You cannot redeem your own referral link');
+       return;
+     }
+ 
+     setIsRedeeming(true);
+     setError('');
+ 
+     try {
+       const amount = method === 'online' ? parseInt(orderAmount) * 100 : 10000; // Default $100 for in-store
+       const discount = calculateDiscount(amount);
+ 
+       const response = await fetch('/api/redemptions', {
+         method: 'POST',
+         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+         body: JSON.stringify({
+           voucherId: voucher.id,
+           referralId: referral.id,
+           method,
+           amountBeforeDiscount: amount,
+           discountApplied: discount,
+           currency: voucher.currency,
+         }),
+       });
+ 
+       const data = await response.json();
+ 
+       if (!response.ok) {
+         throw new Error(data.error || 'Redemption failed');
+       }
+ 
+       if (method === 'in_store') {
+         alert('Redemption created! Please wait for merchant confirmation.');
+       } else {
+         alert(&#96;Discount applied: ${formatCurrency(discount, voucher.currency)}&#96;);
+       }
+ 
+       router.refresh();
+     } catch (err: any) {
+       setError(err.message || 'Redemption failed');
+     } finally {
+       setIsRedeeming(false);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div
+       className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-4"
+       style={{
+         backgroundColor: brandColors?.background || design?.backgroundColor || '#ffffff',
+       }}
+     &gt;
+       &lt;Card
+         className="w-full max-w-md"
+         style={{
+           borderColor: brandColors?.primary || design?.primaryColor,
+         }}
+       &gt;
+         &lt;CardHeader
+           style={{
+             backgroundColor: brandColors?.primary || design?.primaryColor || '#000000',
+             color: '#ffffff',
+           }}
+         &gt;
+           {voucher.merchant.brandLogoUrl &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;img
+               src={voucher.merchant.brandLogoUrl}
+               alt={voucher.merchant.name}
+               className="h-12 mb-4 mx-auto"
+             /&gt;
+           )}
+           &lt;CardTitle className="text-3xl text-center"&gt;{getVoucherValue()}&lt;/CardTitle&gt;
+           &lt;CardDescription className="text-center text-white/90"&gt;
+             {design?.headline || 'Special Offer'}
+           &lt;/CardDescription&gt;
+           {referral.referrer.name &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;p className="text-sm text-center text-white/80 mt-2"&gt;
+               Shared by {referral.referrer.name}
+             &lt;/p&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/CardHeader&gt;
+         &lt;CardContent className="pt-6 space-y-4"&gt;
+           &lt;div className="text-center"&gt;
+             &lt;p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2"&gt;Voucher Code&lt;/p&gt;
+             &lt;p className="text-2xl font-mono font-bold"&gt;{voucherCode}&lt;/p&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+           {qrCodeDataUrl &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;div className="flex justify-center"&gt;
+               &lt;Image
+                 src={qrCodeDataUrl}
+                 alt="QR Code"
+                 width={200}
+                 height={200}
+                 className="border rounded"
+               /&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )}
+ 
+           &lt;div className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground"&gt;
+             &lt;p&gt;Valid until {new Date(voucher.validTo).toLocaleDateString()}&lt;/p&gt;
+             {design?.finePrint &amp;&amp; &lt;p className="mt-2"&gt;{design.finePrint}&lt;/p&gt;}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+           {error &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;div className="bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm p-3 rounded"&gt;
+               {error}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )}
+ 
+           {isSelfReferral ? (
+             &lt;div className="bg-muted text-muted-foreground text-sm p-3 rounded text-center"&gt;
+               You cannot redeem your own referral link
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           ) : (
+             &lt;div className="space-y-3"&gt;
+               &lt;div&gt;
+                 &lt;label className="text-sm font-medium mb-2 block"&gt;Order Amount&lt;/label&gt;
+                 &lt;Input
+                   type="number"
+                   placeholder="Enter amount"
+                   value={orderAmount}
+                   onChange={(e) =&gt; setOrderAmount(e.target.value)}
+                   disabled={isRedeeming}
+                 /&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+               &lt;Button
+                 className="w-full"
+                 onClick={() =&gt; handleRedeem('online')}
+                 disabled={!orderAmount || isRedeeming}
+               &gt;
+                 {isRedeeming ? 'Processing...' : 'Redeem Online'}
+               &lt;/Button&gt;
+               &lt;Button
+                 variant="outline"
+                 className="w-full"
+                 onClick={() =&gt; handleRedeem('in_store')}
+                 disabled={isRedeeming}
+               &gt;
+                 {isRedeeming ? 'Processing...' : 'Redeem In-Store (Staff Scan)'}
+               &lt;/Button&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/CardContent&gt;
+       &lt;/Card&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ }

+ 'use client';
+ 
+ import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
+ import { useParams } from 'next/navigation';
+ import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
+ import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
+ import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
+ import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
+ import { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils';
+ 
+ export default function CheckoutDemoPage() {
+   const params = useParams();
+   const merchantSlug = params.merchantSlug as string;
+   const [orderAmount, setOrderAmount] = useState('');
+   const [creditAmount, setCreditAmount] = useState('');
+   const [balance, setBalance] = useState&lt;any&gt;(null);
+   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
+   const [error, setError] = useState('');
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     fetch(&#96;/api/wallet/${merchantSlug}&#96;)
+       .then((res) =&gt; res.json())
+       .then((data) =&gt; {
+         setBalance(data);
+         if (data.available &gt; 0) {
+           setCreditAmount(String(data.available / 100));
+         }
+       })
+       .catch((err) =&gt; {
+         console.error('Error fetching balance:', err);
+       });
+   }, [merchantSlug]);
+ 
+   const handleApplyCredit = async () =&gt; {
+     if (!creditAmount || !orderAmount) {
+       setError('Please enter both order amount and credit amount');
+       return;
+     }
+ 
+     setIsLoading(true);
+     setError('');
+ 
+     try {
+       const creditAmountCents = parseInt(creditAmount) * 100;
+       const response = await fetch('/api/credits/apply', {
+         method: 'POST',
+         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+         body: JSON.stringify({
+           merchantSlug,
+           amount: creditAmountCents,
+           orderReference: &#96;DEMO-${Date.now()}&#96;,
+         }),
+       });
+ 
+       const data = await response.json();
+ 
+       if (!response.ok) {
+         throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed to apply credit');
+       }
+ 
+       alert(&#96;Credit applied successfully! Order total: ${formatCurrency(
+         parseInt(orderAmount) * 100 - creditAmountCents,
+         balance?.currency || 'USD'
+       )}&#96;);
+ 
+       // Refresh balance
+       const balanceRes = await fetch(&#96;/api/wallet/${merchantSlug}&#96;);
+       const balanceData = await balanceRes.json();
+       setBalance(balanceData);
+       setCreditAmount(String(balanceData.available / 100));
+     } catch (err: any) {
+       setError(err.message || 'Failed to apply credit');
+     } finally {
+       setIsLoading(false);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const finalAmount = orderAmount &amp;&amp; creditAmount
+     ? Math.max(0, parseInt(orderAmount) - parseInt(creditAmount))
+     : 0;
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="min-h-screen p-4"&gt;
+       &lt;div className="container mx-auto max-w-2xl"&gt;
+         &lt;h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-6"&gt;Checkout Demo&lt;/h1&gt;
+ 
+         &lt;Card className="mb-6"&gt;
+           &lt;CardHeader&gt;
+             &lt;CardTitle&gt;Credit Balance&lt;/CardTitle&gt;
+           &lt;/CardHeader&gt;
+           &lt;CardContent&gt;
+             {balance ? (
+               &lt;div&gt;
+                 &lt;p className="text-2xl font-bold"&gt;
+                   {formatCurrency(balance.available, balance.currency)} available
+                 &lt;/p&gt;
+                 {balance.locked &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+                   &lt;p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1"&gt;
+                     {formatCurrency(balance.locked, balance.currency)} locked
+                   &lt;/p&gt;
+                 )}
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             ) : (
+               &lt;p className="text-muted-foreground"&gt;Loading...&lt;/p&gt;
+             )}
+           &lt;/CardContent&gt;
+         &lt;/Card&gt;
+ 
+         &lt;Card&gt;
+           &lt;CardHeader&gt;
+             &lt;CardTitle&gt;Order Summary&lt;/CardTitle&gt;
+             &lt;CardDescription&gt;Demo checkout page&lt;/CardDescription&gt;
+           &lt;/CardHeader&gt;
+           &lt;CardContent className="space-y-4"&gt;
+             &lt;div&gt;
+               &lt;Label htmlFor="orderAmount"&gt;Order Amount&lt;/Label&gt;
+               &lt;Input
+                 id="orderAmount"
+                 type="number"
+                 placeholder="100.00"
+                 value={orderAmount}
+                 onChange={(e) =&gt; setOrderAmount(e.target.value)}
+               /&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             &lt;div&gt;
+               &lt;Label htmlFor="creditAmount"&gt;Credit to Apply&lt;/Label&gt;
+               &lt;Input
+                 id="creditAmount"
+                 type="number"
+                 placeholder="0.00"
+                 value={creditAmount}
+                 onChange={(e) =&gt; setCreditAmount(e.target.value)}
+                 max={balance ? String(balance.available / 100) : undefined}
+               /&gt;
+               {balance &amp;&amp; (
+                 &lt;p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1"&gt;
+                   Max: {formatCurrency(balance.available, balance.currency)}
+                 &lt;/p&gt;
+               )}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             {error &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;div className="bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm p-3 rounded"&gt;
+                 {error}
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             )}
+ 
+             &lt;div className="border-t pt-4 space-y-2"&gt;
+               &lt;div className="flex justify-between"&gt;
+                 &lt;span&gt;Subtotal&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;span&gt;{orderAmount ? formatCurrency(parseInt(orderAmount) * 100, balance?.currency || 'USD') : '$0.00'}&lt;/span&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+               &lt;div className="flex justify-between text-muted-foreground"&gt;
+                 &lt;span&gt;Credit Applied&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;span&gt;-{creditAmount ? formatCurrency(parseInt(creditAmount) * 100, balance?.currency || 'USD') : '$0.00'}&lt;/span&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+               &lt;div className="flex justify-between font-bold text-lg border-t pt-2"&gt;
+                 &lt;span&gt;Total&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;span&gt;{formatCurrency(finalAmount * 100, balance?.currency || 'USD')}&lt;/span&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             &lt;Button
+               className="w-full"
+               onClick={handleApplyCredit}
+               disabled={!orderAmount || !creditAmount || isLoading || !balance || balance.available === 0}
+             &gt;
+               {isLoading ? 'Processing...' : 'Apply Credit &amp; Complete Order'}
+             &lt;/Button&gt;
+           &lt;/CardContent&gt;
+         &lt;/Card&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ }
+

+ import { notFound, redirect } from 'next/navigation';
+ import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';

+     prisma.redemption.count({
+       where: { merchantId: merchant.id, confirmedAt: { not: null } },
+     }),
+     prisma.redemption.count({
+       where: { merchantId: merchant.id, confirmedAt: null },
+     }),
+     prisma.creditLedger.aggregate({
+       where: { merchantId: merchant.id },
+       _sum: { amount: true },
+     }),
+   ]);
+ 
+   return (

+             &lt;/CardHeader&gt;
+             &lt;CardContent&gt;
+               &lt;p className="text-3xl font-bold"&gt;{voucherCount}&lt;/p&gt;
+             &lt;/CardContent&gt;
+           &lt;/Card&gt;
+           &lt;Card&gt;
+             &lt;CardHeader&gt;
+               &lt;CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground"&gt;Redemptions&lt;/CardTitle&gt;
+             &lt;/CardHeader&gt;
+             &lt;CardContent&gt;
+               &lt;p className="text-3xl font-bold"&gt;{redemptionCount}&lt;/p&gt;
+             &lt;/CardContent&gt;
+           &lt;/Card&gt;
+           &lt;Card&gt;
+             &lt;CardHeader&gt;
+               &lt;CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground"&gt;Pending Confirmations&lt;/CardTitle&gt;
+             &lt;/CardHeader&gt;
+             &lt;CardContent&gt;
+               &lt;p className="text-3xl font-bold"&gt;{pendingRedemptions}&lt;/p&gt;
+             &lt;/CardContent&gt;
+           &lt;/Card&gt;
+           &lt;Card&gt;
+             &lt;CardHeader&gt;
+               &lt;CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground"&gt;Credits Issued&lt;/CardTitle&gt;
+             &lt;/CardHeader&gt;
+             &lt;CardContent&gt;

+ import { useState } from 'react';

+ 
+ export default function ConfirmRedemptionButton({
+   redemptionId,
+   merchantSlug,
+ }: {
+   redemptionId: string;
+   merchantSlug: string;
+ }) {
+   const router = useRouter();
+   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
+ 
+   const handleConfirm = async () =&gt; {
+     if (!confirm('Confirm this redemption? This will unlock credit for the referrer.')) {
+       return;
+     }
+ 
+     setIsLoading(true);

+       const response = await fetch(&#96;/api/redemptions/${redemptionId}/confirm&#96;, {

+       });
+ 
+       if (!response.ok) {
+         throw new Error('Failed to confirm redemption');
+       }
+ 
+       router.refresh();
+     } catch (error) {
+       alert('Failed to confirm redemption');
+       console.error(error);
+     } finally {
+       setIsLoading(false);
+     }
+   };

+   return (
+     &lt;Button onClick={handleConfirm} disabled={isLoading}&gt;
+       {isLoading ? 'Confirming...' : 'Confirm Redemption'}
+     &lt;/Button&gt;
+   );
+ }

- 
+ import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
+ import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
+ import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth';
+ import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
+ import { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';
+ import { z } from 'zod';
+ 
+ const claimSchema = z.object({
+   voucherId: z.string(),
+   friendHint: z.string().optional(),
+ });
+ 
+ export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
+   try {
+     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
+     if (!session?.user?.id) {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
+     }
+ 
+     const body = await req.json();
+     const { voucherId, friendHint } = claimSchema.parse(body);
+ 
+     // Get voucher with weekly drop info
+     const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({
+       where: { id: voucherId },
+     });
+ 
+     if (!voucher || !voucher.weeklyDropEnabled) {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found or weekly drop not enabled' }, { status: 404 });
+     }
+ 
+     if (voucher.status !== 'published') {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });
+     }
+ 
+     const weeklyDrop = voucher.weeklyDropJson
+       ? (JSON.parse(voucher.weeklyDropJson as string) as {
+           dayOfWeek: number;
+           startTime: string;
+           stock: number;
+           durationMinutes: number;
+         })
+       : null;
+ 
+     if (!weeklyDrop) {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop configuration missing' }, { status: 400 });
+     }
+ 
+     // Check if we're in the drop window
+     const now = new Date();
+     const dayOfWeek = now.getDay();
+     const [hours, minutes] = weeklyDrop.startTime.split(':').map(Number);
+     const startTime = new Date(now);
+     startTime.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);
+     const endTime = new Date(startTime);
+     endTime.setMinutes(endTime.getMinutes() + weeklyDrop.durationMinutes);
+ 
+     if (dayOfWeek !== weeklyDrop.dayOfWeek || now &lt; startTime || now &gt; endTime) {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop not active' }, { status: 400 });
+     }
+ 
+     // Atomically check stock and create referral
+     const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {
+       // Count existing referrals for this voucher created in this drop window
+       const existingCount = await tx.referral.count({
+         where: {
+           voucherId: voucher.id,
+           createdAt: {
+             gte: startTime,
+             lte: endTime,
+           },
+         },
+       });
+ 
+       if (existingCount &gt;= weeklyDrop.stock) {
+         throw new Error('Weekly drop sold out');
+       }
+ 
+       // Create referral
+       const friendHash = friendHint
+         ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)
+         : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;
+ 
+       const referral = await tx.referral.create({
+         data: {
+           voucherId: voucher.id,
+           merchantId: voucher.merchantId,
+           referrerUserId: session.user.id,
+           friendHash,
+           status: 'created',
+         },
+       });
+ 
+       return referral;
+     });
+ 
+     const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${result.id}&#96;;
+ 
+     return NextResponse.json({
+       referralId: result.id,
+       shareUrl,
+       remaining: weeklyDrop.stock - 1, // Approximate
+     });
+   } catch (error) {
+     if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });
+     }
+     if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message === 'Weekly drop sold out') {
+       return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 409 });
+     }
+     console.error('Error claiming weekly drop:', error);
+     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });
+   }
+ }
+

+                     placeholder="CH"
+                     maxLength={10}
+                   /&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+

+                 &lt;div className="border rounded-lg p-4" style={{ backgroundColor: formData.designBackgroundColor }}&gt;
+                   &lt;div
+                     className="p-4 rounded text-white mb-4"
+                     style={{ backgroundColor: formData.designPrimaryColor }}
+                   &gt;
+                     &lt;h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-center"&gt;
+                       {formData.designHeadline || 'Voucher Headline'}
+                     &lt;/h3&gt;
+                   &lt;/div&gt;
+                   &lt;p className="text-sm text-center text-muted-foreground"&gt;
+                     {formData.designFinePrint || 'Fine print text'}
+                   &lt;/p&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+                 &lt;div className="flex gap-2"&gt;
+                   &lt;Button type="button" onClick={() =&gt; setStep(2)} variant="outline" className="flex-1"&gt;
+                     Back
+                   &lt;/Button&gt;
+                   &lt;Button type="submit" disabled={isLoading} className="flex-1"&gt;
+                     {isLoading ? 'Creating...' : 'Create Voucher'}
+                   &lt;/Button&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               &lt;/CardContent&gt;
+             &lt;/Card&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/form&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ }
+

- 
+ # Voucher Platform
+ 
+ A production-ready, global, multi-tenant "Referral Voucher + Merchant Credit" platform that works on Web and Mobile (PWA-first).
+ 
+ ## Features
+ 
+ - **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data
+ - **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs
+ - **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit
+ - **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire
+ - **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management
+ - **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation
+ - **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)
+ - **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals
+ 
+ ## Tech Stack
+ 
+ - **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui
+ - **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth
+ - **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM
+ - **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)
+ - **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth
+ 
+ ## Getting Started
+ 
+ ### Prerequisites
+ 
+ - Node.js 18+
+ - Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)
+ - PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)
+ 
+ ### Installation
+ 
+ 1. Clone the repository:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;
+ cd voucher
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 2. Install dependencies:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ npm install
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 3. Set up environment variables:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ cp .env.example .env
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ Edit &#96;.env&#96; and configure:
+ - &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96;: PostgreSQL connection string
+ - &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96;: Random string (min 32 chars)
+ - &#96;NEXTAUTH_SECRET&#96;: Random string (min 32 chars)
+ - OAuth providers (optional for local dev)
+ - SMTP settings (for email magic links)
+ 
+ 4. Start Docker services:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ docker-compose up -d
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 5. Run database migrations:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ npm run db:push
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 6. Seed the database:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ npm run db:seed
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 7. Start the development server:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ npm run dev
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) in your browser.
+ 
+ ## Project Structure
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ ├── app/                    # Next.js App Router pages
+ │   ├── api/               # API route handlers
+ │   ├── app/               # User app pages
+ │   ├── merchant/          # Merchant dashboard
+ │   ├── m/                 # Public merchant pages
+ │   ├── v/                 # Public voucher pages
+ │   └── r/                 # Public referral pages
+ ├── components/            # React components
+ │   └── ui/               # shadcn/ui components
+ ├── lib/                   # Utility libraries
+ │   ├── auth.ts           # NextAuth configuration
+ │   ├── rbac.ts           # Role-based access control
+ │   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities
+ │   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention
+ │   └── credits.ts        # Credit management
+ ├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations
+ │   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema
+ │   └── seed.ts           # Seed script
+ └── public/               # Static assets
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Core Flows
+ 
+ ### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher
+ 
+ 1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;
+ 2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)
+ 3. Configure weekly drop (optional)
+ 4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)
+ 5. Publish voucher
+ 
+ ### 2. User Shares Voucher
+ 
+ 1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)
+ 2. Clicks "Share &amp; Earn Credit"
+ 3. System creates referral and generates share URL
+ 4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy
+ 
+ ### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher
+ 
+ 1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)
+ 2. Sees branded voucher with QR code
+ 3. Redeems online or in-store
+ 4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)
+ 5. Locked credit created for referrer
+ 
+ ### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption
+ 
+ 1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;
+ 2. Confirms in-store redemption
+ 3. Credit unlocks for referrer
+ 
+ ### 5. Referrer Uses Credit
+ 
+ 1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;
+ 2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;
+ 3. Apply credit to order
+ 
+ ## API Endpoints
+ 
+ ### Merchant Vouchers
+ - &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher
+ - &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers
+ 
+ ### Referrals
+ - &#96;POST /api/referrals/create&#96; - Create referral and get share URL
+ 
+ ### Redemptions
+ - &#96;POST /api/redemptions&#96; - Create redemption
+ - &#96;POST /api/redemptions/[id]/confirm&#96; - Confirm redemption (staff)
+ 
+ ### Credits
+ - &#96;GET /api/wallet/[merchantSlug]&#96; - Get credit balance
+ - &#96;POST /api/credits/apply&#96; - Apply credit to order
+ 
+ ### Weekly Drop
+ - &#96;POST /api/weekly-drop/claim&#96; - Claim weekly drop stock
+ 
+ ## Database Schema
+ 
+ Key models:
+ - &#96;Merchant&#96;: Tenant information
+ - &#96;User&#96;: Platform users
+ - &#96;MerchantMember&#96;: User-merchant relationships with roles
+ - &#96;Voucher&#96;: Voucher definitions
+ - &#96;Referral&#96;: Referral instances
+ - &#96;Redemption&#96;: Redemption records
+ - &#96;CreditLedger&#96;: Credit transactions
+ - &#96;CreditUsage&#96;: Credit application records
+ - &#96;AuditLog&#96;: Audit trail
+ 
+ See &#96;prisma/schema.prisma&#96; for full schema.
+ 
+ ## Business Rules
+ 
+ 1. **Credit is NOT cash**: Cannot be transferred or withdrawn
+ 2. **Per-merchant credits**: Credits are merchant-specific
+ 3. **Credit expiration**: Default 60 days (configurable per merchant)
+ 4. **Self-referral prevention**: Users cannot redeem their own referrals
+ 5. **Credit locking**: Credits start as LOCKED, unlock after redemption confirmation
+ 6. **Weekly drop stock**: Enforced atomically
+ 7. **Usage limits**: Total and per-user limits enforced
+ 
+ ## Testing
+ 
+ Run tests:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ npm test
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Deployment
+ 
+ ### Environment Variables
+ 
+ Ensure all required environment variables are set in production:
+ - Database connection
+ - Auth secrets
+ - OAuth provider credentials
+ - SMTP settings
+ - Object storage (for brand assets)
+ 
+ ### Database Migrations
+ 
+ In production, use migrations:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ npm run db:migrate
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Build
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ npm run build
+ npm start
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Documentation
+ 
+ - [API Documentation](./docs/API.md)
+ - [How to Add a New Locale](./docs/I18N.md)
+ - [How to Add a New Merchant Currency](./docs/CURRENCIES.md)
+ 
+ ## License
+ 
+ [Your License Here]
+

+ # API Documentation
+ 
+ ## Authentication
+ 
+ Most endpoints require authentication via NextAuth session cookie. Include the session cookie in requests.
+ 
+ ## Endpoints
+ 
+ ### Merchant Vouchers
+ 
+ #### Create Voucher
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Auth**: Merchant admin required
+ 
+ **Body**:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;json
+ {
+   "type": "percentage" | "fixed_amount" | "credit_amount",
+   "value": 1500,  // basis points for percentage, minor units for money
+   "currency": "USD",
+   "validFrom": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",
+   "validTo": "2024-01-31T23:59:59Z",
+   "usageLimitTotal": 100,  // optional
+   "usageLimitPerUser": 1,  // optional
+   "weeklyDropEnabled": false,
+   "weeklyDropJson": {  // optional
+     "dayOfWeek": 1,
+     "startTime": "10:00",
+     "stock": 20,
+     "durationMinutes": 60
+   },
+   "designJson": {
+     "headline": "15% Off",
+     "finePrint": "Valid for new customers",
+     "primaryColor": "#000000",
+     "secondaryColor": "#666666",
+     "backgroundColor": "#ffffff"
+   },
+   "codePrefix": "CH"  // optional
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Response**: Voucher object
+ 
+ #### List Vouchers
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Auth**: Optional (public sees only published)
+ 
+ **Response**: Array of voucher objects
+ 
+ ### Referrals
+ 
+ #### Create Referral
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ POST /api/referrals/create
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Auth**: Required
+ 
+ **Body**:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;json
+ {
+   "voucherId": "clx...",
+   "friendHint": "friend@example.com"  // optional
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Response**:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;json
+ {
+   "referralId": "clx...",
+   "shareUrl": "https://app.com/r/clx..."
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Redemptions
+ 
+ #### Create Redemption
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ POST /api/redemptions
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Auth**: Optional (for tracking)
+ 
+ **Body**:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;json
+ {
+   "voucherId": "clx...",
+   "referralId": "clx...",  // optional
+   "method": "online" | "in_store",
+   "orderReference": "ORD-001",  // optional
+   "amountBeforeDiscount": 5000,  // minor units
+   "discountApplied": 750,  // minor units
+   "currency": "USD"
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Response**:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;json
+ {
+   "redemptionId": "clx...",
+   "requiresConfirmation": false
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ #### Confirm Redemption
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ POST /api/redemptions/[id]/confirm
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Auth**: Merchant staff required
+ 
+ **Response**:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;json
+ {
+   "success": true
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Credits
+ 
+ #### Get Wallet
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ GET /api/wallet/[merchantSlug]
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Auth**: Required
+ 
+ **Response**:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;json
+ {
+   "available": 5000,  // minor units
+   "locked": 1000,
+   "total": 6000,
+   "currency": "USD",
+   "credits": [...]
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ #### Apply Credit
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ POST /api/credits/apply
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Auth**: Required
+ 
+ **Body**:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;json
+ {
+   "merchantSlug": "coffee-house",
+   "amount": 5000,  // minor units
+   "orderReference": "ORD-001"  // optional
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Response**:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;json
+ {
+   "success": true,
+   "creditIds": ["clx..."]
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Weekly Drop
+ 
+ #### Claim Weekly Drop
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ POST /api/weekly-drop/claim
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Auth**: Required
+ 
+ **Body**:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;json
+ {
+   "voucherId": "clx...",
+   "friendHint": "friend@example.com"  // optional
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Response**:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;json
+ {
+   "referralId": "clx...",
+   "shareUrl": "https://app.com/r/clx...",
+   "remaining": 19
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Error Responses
+ 
+ All errors follow this format:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;json
+ {
+   "error": "Error message"
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ Status codes:
+ - &#96;400&#96;: Bad Request (validation error)
+ - &#96;401&#96;: Unauthorized
+ - &#96;403&#96;: Forbidden (insufficient permissions)
+ - &#96;404&#96;: Not Found
+ - &#96;409&#96;: Conflict (e.g., weekly drop sold out)
+ - &#96;429&#96;: Rate Limit Exceeded
+ - &#96;500&#96;: Internal Server Error
+ 
```

</details>
